pets.name: 绒团兔
pets.description: Small compact cream rabbit, round pear body, short folded ears, a huge fluffy cotton tail, soft peach belly. Tiny companion, no armor.

pets.name: 潮泡獭
pets.description: Small aqua otter pup, round cream muzzle, translucent blue bubble collar, broad paddle tail and tiny webbed feet, playful and compact.

pets.name: 蓄电貂
pets.description: Small slim golden marten with teal capacitor-like ear tufts, black zigzag back stripe and a short curled cable-like tail ending in two golden prongs. No red cheek circles.

pets.name: 霜团海豹
pets.description: Small plump pale-blue seal pup, white snowball belly, tiny icy flipper fins, three clear ice crystals like a little crown, very round cute body.

pets.name: 拳铠猿
pets.description: Large muscular but cute upright copper-red gorilla, broad shoulders, heavy stone-like ivory forearm gauntlets organically grown, deep navy chest and red crest, thick limbs, clear elite silhouette. No weapon.

pets.name: 毒泡蜗
pets.description: Small violet sea slug with lime-green translucent bubble shell, two short curled feelers, stubby body, cute sleepy eyes, three small poison-green spots.

pets.name: 铲角鼹
pets.description: Small sandy tan mole pup with rounded shovel-shaped nose horn, broad dark-brown digging paws, terracotta back plates, compact squat body.

pets.name: 云翎雀
pets.description: Small sky-blue songbird with fluffy white cloud wing tips and a curled breeze-shaped crest, tiny feet, pale gold beak, simple round body.

pets.name: 星环鸮
pets.description: Large regal violet owl mage creature, broad wing mantle, two floating golden orbital rings behind shoulders, lilac chest diamond, bright turquoise eyes, imposing wide silhouette, visible short talons. Not humanoid.

pets.name: 芽角甲虫
pets.description: Small emerald beetle with two broad rounded elytra, ivory forked sprout-shaped horn, six short friendly legs, amber eyes, peach underside, round compact beetle.

pets.name: 灯芯幽灵
pets.description: Small lavender ghost resembling a soft floating lantern, cream glowing face, two droopy little wispy arms, short curled ghost tail instead of feet, tiny blue flame tuft. Cute rather than scary.

pets.name: 霆冠龙
pets.description: Huge majestic quadrupedal indigo dragon, broad chest and powerful legs, enormous swept-back ivory crown horns, large layered turquoise bat wings, glowing gold chest diamond, thick armored tail. Epic king silhouette unmistakably a BOSS, not a baby, still appealing collectible monster. Entire wings contained.

pets.name: 暮影猞猁
pets.description: Small charcoal-purple lynx kitten, huge pointed ears with crescent tufts, dark plum fluffy tail, cream eye mask and tiny golden eyes, mischievous appealing short-legged body.

pets.name: 铁垒犀
pets.description: Huge powerful quadrupedal steel rhinoceros fortress creature, oversized silver shoulder plates and broad navy chest, large smooth bronze nose horn, stepped shield-like back armor, thick solid legs with bronze hooves, turquoise glowing seams. Epic armored BOSS silhouette, no guns or buildings.

pets.name: 铃芽鹿
pets.description: Small pastel pink fawn with cream face and tiny golden bell-shaped antlers, mint bow-shaped ear fur, one star-shaped tail tuft, delicate short legs and round baby body.

spec.style: original cute collectible monsters, clean dark outlines, cel-shaded color, same design and proportions in both views
